verdict.rationale: Retell's Conductor is a first-party in-product AI assistant that inspects calls/chats, knowledge bases, AI QA results, contacts, and analytics data and proposes plain-language insights and changes for review, directly matching the story; AI QA also automatically scores calls to surface quality trends. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of Conductor's insight quality and no third-party validation beyond vendor docs.
